name: Counting Valleys
description: A hiker starts and ends at sea level. Each step in the path is either 'U' (one unit up) or 'D' (one unit down). A valley is a sequence of consecutive steps below sea level, starting with a step down from sea level and ending with a step up to sea level. Count the valleys walked through.
shortDescription: Count valleys walked through on a hike
